narrator_hint: seventh-storyteller / ending routes: several characters; work out the speaker from context

rows.en:
"{f:Quit screwing around|Stop messing with me}! How far will you go making a fool of {f:me|me} before you're {f:satisfied|satisfied}?☆ Just because you're a senior, {f:quit|stop} acting so high and mighty-y-y-y!☆"
With that, {f:I|I} grabbed Kazama by the collar and yanked him close.{p}

"Whoooaaargh!☆"
Kazama suddenly let out a war cry.
{f:I|I} jumped back in surprise.
And then, {f:lo and behold|what do you know}, Kazama and the ammonite freak began to give off an eerie glow.
Their muscles bulged, and with loud rips they tore their clothes apart.
The skin of Kazama's face split open too, and a head just like the ammonite freak's came out.{p}

...This {f:isn't|isn't} one of Hino's pranks.
I don't think even Hino would go as far as special-effects makeup like this just for a joke.
Standing there were two musclebound ammonite freaks... no, two Sunbararians.
"When danger approaches, we transform into our battle form. You are not a Sunbararian, are you? You are a spy posing as a Sunbararian, aren't you?★ So that's it, after all!☆ Now that we know you are a spy, you must die!☆"
The former Kazama and the Commander crept closer and closer to {f:me|me},
stretching out the slimy tentacles around their mouths...{p}

Just then, streaks of white light shot past at tremendous speed, grazing both of {f:my|my} cheeks.
They struck the two beefy Sunbararians.
With a loud hiss, the Sunbararians melted away.
A burnt smell filled the air.
Timidly, {f:I|I} turned to look behind me.{p}

"Wh-what's this?★"
Standing there was a handsome young man holding something like a laser gun.
He {f:seemed|seemed} to be striking some kind of pose.
He wore a skintight outfit like a wetsuit, silver and glittering with lamé.
His hair was purple, silky and perfectly straight, reaching down to his waist.
His eyes were a pale purple too.{p}

"Are you all right? Don't worry, I'm with the Space Police. A while back, we got intel that the Sunbararians were plotting to invade Earth. I got worried and dropped by, and look what I found... A little later and you'd have been killed, along with every Earthling. I'm really glad I made it in time. Well, I'll be off."{p}

With that, the young man's body began to give off light.
Then he turned into a ball of light, smashed through the club room window and flew away...{p}

The two Sunbararians had vanished without a trace.
Thanks to that young man, the Earth had escaped its crisis.
...But.
Maybe this had all been {f:my|my} dream.
Yes, that {f:was it|had to be it}...
On an impulse, {f:I|I} looked out the window.{p}
The sky was full of twinkling stars.{p}

But {f:hold|wait} {f:on|a sec}...
Just letting Hino and the others make fun of me like this {f:is|is} kind of galling.
If they're going to tease {f:me|me}, then {f:I'll|I'll} play along with it all the way!
{f:I|I} saluted the Commander.{p}

{f:I|I} spoke up on the spot.
"Owing to certain circumstances, I came to make his acquaintance in this manner, sir.
By the way, Commander. Your appearance may be fine as it is, but unless we do something about the Sunbararian language, anyone who happens to overhear us will grow suspicious.
I believe it would be wise to switch to the language spoken here."{p}

The Commander seemed lost in thought for a while.
"...Very well. As you say, I will speak the language of this place.
What you say is never wrong, after all."
The Commander said this while looking at {f:me|me}.
{f:I|I} made a proposal to the Commander.{p}

"As it happens, I came to this Earth under special orders...
And while secretly investigating the Earthlings, I have discovered something.
It has become clear that, for Earthlings, there exists a separate world known as the spirit world."
The Commander and Kazama listened to {f:my|my} story with great interest.
{f:I|I} rattled on at them without pausing for breath.{p}

"They say that in this so-called spirit world, there is a paradise that even Earthlings long for. I investigated it on my own as well. Apparently ordinary people can hardly ever get there. ...However, I have finally discovered it! The way to reach that paradise!☆"
The Commander and Kazama cried out in admiration.
"How can one get there?!"
{f:I|I} spoke, milking the moment.
"Do you want to know?"
They both nodded hard.
"Then, both of you, please take off all your clothes."{p}Would the two of them {f:do|do} what {f:I|I} said?
They'll do it
They won't

The two of them said in unison,
"...All right, understood!"
{f:I|I} didn't much want to see them naked, but it {f:was|was} their punishment for trying to fool {f:me|me}.
Sorry, but {f:I'll|I'll} have {f:you|you} strip down to something shameful.
"Please hand me the clothes you take off. Then stand side by side by the window."
{f:I|I} felt a little smug watching them do exactly as they were told.
Honestly, Hino and the others just love getting carried away with a gag.
"Close your eyes and concentrate your minds."
Meaning to give them a scare, {f:I|I} pointed the toy gun the Commander had been carrying at them.
"Now, please turn this way."{p}

The two of them were shocked when they saw {f:me|me}.
"Wh-what are you doing? Point a gun at the Commander and you'll be executed! Stop this foolishness and put that gun away at once!☆"
Kazama said to {f:me|me}, shielding the Commander.
"Kazama, Hino, that's enough already. Even someone as easygoing as {f:me|me} can't take any more of this. ...If you love jokes that much... then here's one for you!"
With that, {f:I|I} pulled the trigger of the toy gun.
And then...{p}

When I came to my senses and looked ahead, Kazama and the Commander were lying there, horribly changed.
"Kazama! Hino!☆"
{f:I|I} was on the verge of tears.
Then I ran over to them.{p}

"Urk!"
{f:I|I} felt like throwing up.
The two I'd thought were Kazama and Hino lay dead, in the form of ammonite freaks.
This was no special-effects makeup!☆
So they really {f:were|were} Sunbararians?★{p}

With a loud hissing, the two of them melted and vanished without a trace.
Only now did {f:I|I} tremble at the bold thing I had done.
But {f:I|I} {f:had|had} saved the Earth from disaster.
{f:That's|That's} right, {f:I'm|I'm} a {f:hero|hero}!☆{p}

"I quit!☆ I can't stand this role anymore. Nobody told me it'd go this far."
The Commander slid his mask off with a slurp.
Standing there was a completely ordinary person with an ordinary face.
Kazama spoke to him.{p}

"Come on, that's no good. Play your part properly. I'm only doing this reluctantly because Hino asked me to, you know."
I knew it.
So it {f:was|was} a prank by Hino and the others after all.
I couldn't deal with these people anymore.
Kazama called out.
"Ah, wait a sec!☆"{p}
Not listening to a word of it, {f:I|I} walked out of the club room.{p}
There was nothing left to do but fight.{p}

"{f:Sorry|I'm so sorry}, I never meant for this to happen. Please, forgive me. {f:I'm|I'm} actually an Earthling. {f:I'm|I'm} just a good, ordinary citizen, and I'm definitely not with the Earth Defense Force."
A good citizen who just killed the Commander? Not likely, {f:huh|right}... even I thought so.
Even so, Kazama kept closing in on {f:me|me}, step by step, steadily.
{f:It's no use|It's hopeless}. No matter how much {f:I|I} apologized, he wasn't going to listen.
K-Kazama, if you come any closer, {f:we're|we're} going to be skin to skin.{p}

Aaah, {f:I'm|I'm} {f:done for|finished}!☆
"...? {f:Gyah|Eek}!"
{f:I|I} screamed.
Kazama had fallen toward {f:me|me}.
{f:I|I} ended up catching Kazama's full weight head-on in my arms.
Smelling something burnt, {f:I|I} looked at Kazama's back.
There was a single, gaping, charred hole in his back.
Still holding Kazama, {f:I|I} looked up.{p}

There, in the club room doorway, stood Shindo, smiling.
"Sh-Shindo!☆"
Shindo said with a smile,
"I was worried about you two, so I was watching from outside the club room, and sure enough, Kazama tried to attack you. The Sunbararians are a terrifying bunch."
{f:I|I} took a good look at Shindo.{p}

Looking closely, I saw Shindo was dressed strangely.
He was wrapped in a skintight pink wetsuit, and on top of that, even his hair was pink, {f:if you can believe it|of all things}.
In his right hand he held a gun unlike any I'd ever seen.
Sh-Shindo... who are you?
Seeing the suspicion on {f:my|my} face, Shindo spoke as if he'd just caught on.{p}

"Ah, you're wondering about me, right? What with me dressed like this. That's right, I'm an alien, same as Kazama."
Hold on, out of the frying pan and into the fire, {f:huh|isn't it}?
...Help me.
Perhaps sensing that {f:I|I} was frightened, Shindo went on.{p}

"Don't worry. I may be an alien too, but I'm different from the Sunbararians. Truth is, I'm an Untamarian. My home, planet Untamaru, was invaded by the Sunbararians, and everyone was slaughtered. I only survived because I just happened to be off on another planet. And that planet was Earth. In the end, I got stuck living on Earth for good. I'll never forget how bitter that was. And now, by pure chance, I get to wipe out Sunbararians in a place like this. I'm really, really happy right now."
...After everything that had happened, nothing surprised me anymore.{p}

Shindo {f:seemed|seemed} to be an alien who meant {f:me|me} no harm.
But {f:was|was} it really okay to have this many aliens around {f:me|me}?
With odds this high, even the people {f:I|I} think are Earthlings might be...
...{f:We|We}'re always living right next to danger, {f:aren't we|aren't we}.{p}

……………Why {f:am|am} {f:I|I} lying collapsed here?
……………Shindo {f:seems|seems} to have failed to erase {f:my|my} memory.
This head of mine still clearly remembers what happened back then.
{f:Is this|Could this be} the price of Shindo's failure to erase my memory?
Ever since, {f:I've|I've} been able to see every kind of spirit there is...
That takes care of my seventh scary story, {f:no problem|no problem}.{p}

I had no choice but to run...
...It's no {f:good|use}.
My body wouldn't move, as if I were paralyzed.
Pathetically, my legs {f:seemed|seemed} to be frozen with fear.
{f:I|I} decided my only option was to somehow bluff my way out of this.{p}

I asked Kazama,
"Now I'll {f:prove|prove} to you that the Commander was a Deberondattan. You remember what color the bodily fluids of {f:us|us} Sunbararians are, {f:right|don't you}?"
Kazama answered obediently.
"They're green."
{f:I|I} calmly took a box cutter from the club room desk and slit the Commander's wrist.
Fluid came gushing out.{p}

...The fluid was pink.
"Seeeee? It's just like {f:I|I} said, {f:right|isn't it}? This guy {f:was|was} a Deberondattan."
{f:I|I} had only been bluffing out of desperation, {f:but|but}...
That the Commander really was a Deberondattan... it {f:was|was} too good to be true.{p}

"No, this one looks like a Deberondattan, but it's a Nyarinian. ...Well, either way, the Commander was a fake."
Kazama told {f:me|me}.
That was close...
So it {f:was|was} a Nyarinian.
{f:I|I} asked,{p}

For an instant, the sky lit up.
Wrapped in dazzling light, {f:I|I} departed for a world I had never seen...
Mom, Dad, {f:I'm|I'm} going to live as Commander of the Sunbararians.
Please forgive {f:me|me} for being such an undutiful child.{p}

For now, maybe {f:I|I} had no choice but to dance and muddle through.
But what {f:should|should} I dance?
The only dances {f:I|I} knew were folk dances.
Oh, what the heck. Here goes nothing.{p}

"Tra-la-la, tra-la-la-la-la-laaa, ta-dum, ta-da-da!☆"
Humming the melody, {f:I|I} started dancing by myself.
I was past caring about being embarrassed.
Then {f:I|I} went round and round the club room table.
{f:I|I} glanced sideways at Kazama.{p}

Kazama was watching {f:me|me} with a sour look.
His gaze stung.
No matter what, I had to keep dancing.
I didn't want to upset this balance.
If {f:I|I} stopped dancing now, there {f:was|was} no telling what would happen.
Just then, Kazama broke the silence.{p}

"{a}, that's enough. Stop dancing.
You've proven splendidly that you're a Sunbararian. It's proven that you're one of the Koppeppo, a brave tribe even among the Sunbararians. I've only seen that dance once myself, but there's no doubt about it. It's a dance handed down among the Koppeppo tribe since ancient times."{p}

I-I didn't know what was going on, but things {f:seemed|seemed} to be going my way.
Just then, a shrill buzzer blared.
Kazama took something like a patch out of his pocket and brought it to his mouth.
"Yes, this is code name ·☆·☆.
My communicator was sounding an alarm. Is something the matter?"
Kazama held the patch up to his ear.{p}

"What?★ But that's... Ah..."
He just stood there, stunned.
Sensing that something serious had happened, {f:I|I} asked quietly,
"...Is something wrong?"{p}

"It's over for us. ...I've just received word from our home planet. Sunbararia has been attacked by the Untamarians and is on the verge of annihilation. That was the last transmission... We barely escaped ourselves, but... Invading Earth is out of the question now. ……………It seems our only option is to survive here on Earth, as Earthlings."
He said this with his shoulders slumped.{p}

{f:I|I} was so overjoyed that I did a little dance where he couldn't see.
I couldn't stop {f:laughing|laughing}.{p}

The pitch-dark sky was full of twinkling stars.
Just then, a shooting star streaked across, trailing its tail.
"Look, Kazama. A shooting star... That's our fallen brethren of Sunbararia. Yes, they've become stars. Oh, look, there goes another one..."
In the night sky, with the rainy season nearly over, the summer constellations could be seen.
{f:We|We} kept watching them for a long, long time.{p}

Maybe I'll just try running for {f:it|it}...
I {f:knew|knew} running was better than trying to fix this situation.
{f:I|I} dashed off.
And {f:I|I} slammed into the club room door as hard as I could.{p}

With a bang, the door came off and {f:I|I} tumbled into the hallway.
Yes, it {f:worked|worked}!☆
This time I could really get away.
Then {f:I|I} looked down the hallway and was struck speechless.
The school hallway was thickly encrusted with what looked like plant roots.
{f:I|I} had nowhere left to run.{p}

"You were a pure Earthling all along, weren't you?
You can't escape now. A little while ago, my Sunbararian brethren sowed the seeds of a special parasitic plant over the entire Earth.
Soon the Earth will have all its nutrients sucked out, and it'll shrivel up.
We tried to rule the Earth, but you Earthlings are just too hard to handle.
So we figured if we're going to rule it, it's better to kill you all."
Before I knew it, Kazama was standing behind {f:me|me}.{p}

"Now, you'll become food for this plant too."
With that, Kazama signaled with his right hand.
The roots clinging to the hallway began stretching toward {f:me|me},
rustling and stirring as they came.
"Struggling is pointless. Don't worry, you won't feel any pain."
Kazama said, smiling at {f:me|me}.{p}

"{f:Waaaaaugh|Eeeeeeeek}!☆"
Countless roots wrapped around {f:my|my} body.
Then a strange sensation enveloped {f:me|me}.
I was fading away...{p}

Before me were human heads hanging from an abnormally huge tree.
Looking closely, I saw they all had their eyes wide open, darting their eyeballs this way and that.
They all {f:seemed|seemed} shocked to find themselves reduced to just heads.
And it {f:looked|looked} like {f:I|I} was just a head too...
Unfortunately, I couldn't make a sound.
Then some Sunbararians came over from the distance.
They were riding something like flying scooters.{p}

"This tree bears fruit shaped just like the creatures its roots suck dry, huh."
"They're nice and ripe. Look delicious."
The Sunbararians licked their lips and began cutting off the stems that connected {f:our|our} heads to the trunk.
"I always think this, but harvest season sure is a pain, huh."
They began harvesting {f:our|our} heads like fruit.
It {f:seemed|seemed} {f:we|we} were worth nothing anymore except as food for the Sunbararians...{p}

"I'm sorry! I'm sorry!
{f:I|I} was lying.
I'm really, truly {f:sorry|sorry}."
{f:I|I} got down on my hands and knees and begged Kazama's forgiveness.
And then...?{p}

"Im-impossible... That pose... the legendary Kyukyuans...!
I thought they'd long since gone extinct, but to meet one in a place like this—how lucky can I get!"
Kazama happily took {f:my|my} hands and danced a little jig.
What on earth {f:was|was} going on?
"I see, it's mimicry. Kyukyuans change themselves to match their surroundings. That's why they were so hard to find. Even these eyes of mine couldn't see through it, so that ability truly is magnificent."
Kazama stood there trembling with emotion all by himself, but {f:I|I} didn't understand any of it.{p}

"Um... what are you talking about? Who are these Kyukyuans?"
"There's no need to hide it. We're not your enemies. Sunbararians may be invaders, but we'd never lay a hand on a Kyukyuan. After all, it was the union of a Kyukyuan and a Purupuruan that gave birth to us, the Sunbararians."{p}

Dun-dun-dunnnnn!☆
Now revealed: the secret of the Sunbararians' birth!
...Yeah, right. This {f:is|is} no time to be goofing around.
Still, with the mood like this, it {f:looks|looks} like I might somehow make it out alive...
I'll sweet-talk him nicely and politely see him on his way.{p}

I noticed Kazama was holding a scrap of paper he'd pulled out from somewhere.
Then he showed the paper to {f:me|me},
"This is a transcription of part of an ancient Kyukyuan manuscript. Can you read it?"
he asked, with a serious look on his face.
The characters written on that paper were...{p}

Nine, sphere, rest......
Every one of them was a character pronounced 'kyu.'
So {f:I|I} simply did as I was asked and went,
"Kyu, kyu, kyu, kyu, kyu......"
reading them out loud.{p}

"This is the Earth expeditionary unit. I have discovered one of our great ancestors, a Kyukyuan! I will now escort this one to Sunbararia. This is one of royal blood. Take every care that no discourtesy is shown."
Kazama, no, the Sunbararian, bowed his head reverently, took {f:my|my} hand, and pressed the switch on the patch.{p}

"Tra-la-la, tra-la-la-la-la-laaa, ta-dum-ta-ta-ta☆"
Humming the melody, {f:I|I} began dancing all by myself.
I was past worrying about how embarrassing it was.
And {f:I|I} went jumping round and round the club room table.{p}

And then he said one thing.
"Wonderful. I've never felt such pleasure before..."
Huh...?
My mind went blank.
Kazama...
Please, I'm begging you, don't say anything weird...
Kazama said happily,
"That dance was the best.
I'm completely intoxicated by it.
I don't care anymore if you're a spy for the Earth Defense Force.
Won't you dance for me for the rest of your life?"
That's practically a marriage proposal{f:...|...} No, this is no time to be thinking such carefree thoughts{f:!|!}
What on earth is that supposed to mean{f:?!|?!}★
As {f:I|I} tried to get away, Kazama hit me with one shocking line.{p}

"Let's get married!"
N-no way...
Kazama, me marrying you is wa-a-ay too much of a stretch{f:!|!}☆
I should never have danced.
There might have been a better way to escape...!
Kazama gripped {f:my|my} hand tightly.
{f:So there's no escape now, huh|So I can't escape anymore, can I}.
All right, now that it's come to this, I'll just have to look on the bright side{f:.|.}
...Ah, what a relief.
After all, I didn't get killed...
Ugh, how hollow☆
...Tears welled up in my eyes.
Feeling utterly resigned, {f:I|I} squeezed his hand back.{p}

{f:That's it|That's it}, maybe {f:I|I} was just seeing things.
I'll take one more look down the hallway.{p}

{f:I|I} carefully peeked out from behind the wall into the hallway.
"Ugh☆"{p}

{f:I|I} hurriedly hid inside the club room's locker.
And there inside the locker, I held my breath.{p}
Then, one after another, the Sunbararians came pouring into the club room from the hallway.{p}

Curious, {f:I|I} watched what was going on through the gap in the locker door.
The Sunbararians stuck tentacles out of their mouths and began groping at the two corpses.
Tentacles stretched out one after another from the mouths of all those Sunbararians and covered the two corpses.
After a while, the tentacles slid back into the mouths they came from.
The two corpses that had been lying there had vanished without a trace.
Had they absorbed them{f:?|?}★{p}

Then the Sunbararians began merging, one after another, with the comrades around them.
Just like lumps of clay sticking together...{p}

In the end, they had turned into a single Sunbararian, at least two meters tall.
The Sunbararian looked around.
Again, tentacles were coming out of its mouth.
Then it looked this way and stopped.
It was coming toward the locker {f:I|I} was hiding in.{p}
It turned out to be pretty sluggish; once it went tumbling over, it couldn't get right back up.

What, that was it? How anticlimactic...
It was nothing, really. Even powered up, their weak spot is still the tentacles{f:, huh|, isn't it}.
You should have thought it through a little more... Sunbararians.
With the same weak spot, you're going to get beaten right away.
{f:What was with this guy, anyway|What was that all about, anyway}...
Exhaustion hit {f:me|me} all at once, and I slumped down right where I was.
But what am I supposed to do with the Sunbararian's corpse{f:...|...}{p}

...............I really can't do it{f:!|!}☆
{f:I|I} just can't☆
Putting on a Sunbararian's head☆
{f:I|I} tossed Kazama's head away.
What do I do!
The sound of the marching Sunbararians was drawing closer and closer.
Suddenly the locker caught my eye.
"That's it{f:!|!}"{p}

Geez, what is with all this, one thing after another{f:!|!}☆
Screw it, here goe-e-es{f:!|!}☆{p}

"☆··☆★☆☆··★☆"
{f:I|I} spouted some gibberish.
"···☆☆★☆☆·?"
They were saying something too.{p}
While I'm at it, I'll show them the patch too.{p}
{f:I|I} held the patch up as high as I possibly could.{p}

"·★☆☆··☆☆★☆"
(Oh, Commander, sir☆ We were worried.
You went off and never came back.
Now, let us hurry back☆)
Whoa, so this patch can translate{f:!|!}★
...Wait a {f:sec|second}, does 'Commander' mean {f:me|me}★
No way.
{f:I'm|I'm} not any commander!{p}

Oh no!
I said something I didn't mean at all.
And so smoothly, too...
So this patch only translates; it doesn't actually interpret for me{f:!|!}☆
"☆···☆☆★☆★·☆"
(Roger! All right, everyone! Are you ready?)
"{f:Waaah|Nooo}☆ Stoooop!"
The Sunbararians hoisted {f:me|me} up, and every one of them held up a patch.{p}
Oh, right{f:!|!} I've still got the patch.{p}

All {f:I|I} could think about was getting back home.
I just had to run.
Run, run, and keep on running{f:!|!}
Luckily, even wearing a thing like this, I made it home without anyone noticing me.
{f:I|I} burst into the house and locked the front door.
Then I went into the kitchen.
It was evening, so Mom was making dinner.
"Mom☆"
{f:I|I} called out to her from behind.
"You're late. Tonight Dad's working overtime, so he'll be la... Eeek☆"
As she turned around, Mom dropped the ladle she was holding.{p}

Ow, it hurts!
Far from coming off, it hurts horribly when I pull on it.{p}

"{b}, you've finally become a grown-up too☆ Mom is so happy. Tonight the whole family is celebrating. It's been thirty years since we assimilated with the Earthlings. We're finally able to live normal lives, too. I'm so happy right now."
Saying that, Mom hugged {f:me|me} tight.{p}

"I'm home!"
{f:My|My} big sister came home.
"Oh, so you've joined the grown-ups too. For me it was back in junior high. Early, right? Guess I was precocious."
She said it with a perfectly casual face.
I don't think that's something you say with a casual face...{p}
{f:I|I} tried to pull off the mask as I ran.{p}

So as not to look suspicious, {f:I|I} picked up a newspaper and draped it over my head.
Though maybe this makes me look even more suspicious.
Luckily, even with this thing on, I made it to the hospital without anyone noticing me.
{f:I|I} slipped in quietly through the back entrance.
This hospital was where {f:my|my} family always went.
I ran to the office of Dr. Tanaka, our doctor.
{f:I|I} slowly opened the door.
It looked like the doctor wasn't there yet{f:.|.}{p}

"Doctor!"
{f:I|I} sprang out from under the desk.{p}

"Whoa☆"
Startled, Dr. Tanaka went tumbling over backward.
Half in tears, {f:I|I} said,
"Doctor! It's {a}! {f:I'm|I'm} {b} {a}!"
Flustered as the doctor was, Dr. Tanaka still spoke to {f:me|me}.
"Wh-what happened? What's with that head? Is it really you, {a}?"
"Dr. Tanaka☆ Please listen to me..."
Like a dam bursting, {f:I|I} poured out everything that had happened.{p}

The doctor was silent for a while.
"...Hmm. From everything you've told me, you really do seem to be {a}. Here, let me have a look. I see, I see... Mm-hmm..."
The doctor carefully examined the seam between {f:my|my} face and the mask.
"All right, {f:I'll|I'll} do something about this. Let's go to the operating room right away."
Keeping {f:me|me} out of sight, the doctor took me to the operating room.{p}

Dr. Tanaka really is someone I can count on.
It was chilly inside the operating room.
"Now, lie down on this operating table. I'm going to put you under. When you wake up, this mask should come right off, nice and clean."
{f:I|I} lay down on the operating table as the doctor said.{p}

"Okay, I'm going to count to ten now. You'll get sleepy soon. One, two, three, four, five, six..."
My consciousness slipped away.{p}

"Using {a}'s name like that, you unforgivable creature. A freak of an alien like you can become research material for us! Ha ha ha!"
No... so the doctor never believed {f:me|me} at all{f:!|!}★
{f:I|I} said to the doctor,
"Doctor, {f:I|I} was just wearing that mask, wasn't I?"
"Don't be stupid. That's no mask. That's your own skin, plain and simple. You've got some nerve, telling such a barefaced lie."
{f:I|I} tried to move my body.{p}
returns: 44:16e1c: RETURN - etai no shirenai rendered 'freak of an alien'; source is 'unknown/sinister', editorial may prefer 'some unknown alien thing'

rows.en:
I have to go to a TV station and tell everyone about this!
That the Sunbararians are invading Earth...
Luckily it was dusk, and I picked deserted streets as I ran.
The TV station wasn't very far from the school.
I'd been there once on a social studies field trip in junior high.
When I reached the TV station, {f:I|I} hid in the bushes and checked for security guards.
It seemed to be right at the shift change; they were chatting in the guard booth{f:.|.}{p}

"Here's my chance!"
{f:I|I} made a dash for it.
Then I slipped quietly in through the back entrance.
First, I checked the program schedule posted on the wall.
"Live shows... this one☆"
A news program caught my eye.
It seemed to have already gone on the air{f:.|.}
"Studio Five{f:, huh|, huh}..."{p}

{f:I|I} pulled off the fishy-smelling mask.
I slowly opened the door.
Then I made my way toward the TV cameras.
Crouching low, {f:I|I} crept closer from behind cover.
The newscaster was talking.{p}

"Ah☆"
{f:I|I} cried out before I could stop myself.
The TV camera turned toward {f:me|me}.
There were several Sunbararians there.
The camera operators, the newscaster, the staff, all of them were Sunbararians.
In the TV camera the Sunbararians were operating, {f:my|my} face showed, twisted in terror...{p}
I can't let it end like this!
Do whatever you want with me

{f:I|I} glanced sideways at Kazama.
Kazama was watching {f:me|me} with a sour look.
...Is this going to be okay?
Maybe he didn't like {f:my|my} Cossack dance{f:?|?}
Still, this might turn out to be a pretty addictive dance.
I've been dancing like this for about five minutes now, but I don't feel very tired.
Suddenly, Kazama clapped his hands loudly.{p}
